newsitem.title: UK: UKs Brown to make statement on Bank of England.
newsitem.headline: UKs Brown to make statement on Bank of England.

text.p: Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown is to make a statement to Parliament at 1430 gmt on Tuesday on the Bank of England, a spokesman for the Treasury said.

He said the statement would be mainly aimed at formally telling MPs about changes to the bank's powers which have already been announced, but that Brown may give additional information. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
